normative_extracts.spec_section: RFC 8297 Section 2: HTTP Status Code 103 (Early Hints)
normative_extracts.quote: The 103 (Early Hints) informational status code indicates to the client that the server is likely to send a final response with the header fields included in the informational response.

normative_extracts.spec_section: WHATWG HTML: Processing Link headers in 103 responses
normative_extracts.quote: A 103 Early Hints response allows the user agent to start preloading or preconnecting to critical subresources while the final response is still being generated.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Emits an interim 103 HTTP frame with Link preload/preconnect headers during server think time, feeding the preload scanner before byte 0 of HTML arrives.

production_failures.symptom: Preloaded fonts or stylesheets via 103 Early Hints are fetched twice
production_failures.root_cause: The 103 Link header omitted crossorigin on a CORS-enabled font, or used a different URL query string than the final HTML.
production_failures.mitigation: Match the exact URL and crossorigin attribute in both the 103 Link header and the HTML document.

production_failures.symptom: 103 Early Hints ignored completely by the browser
production_failures.root_cause: Origin or reverse proxy sent 103 over HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/1.0, where informational 1xx responses are disabled by browsers due to proxy framing bugs.
production_failures.mitigation: Serve 103 Early Hints strictly over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 connections.
